+def merge_security_definition(
+    existing: Dict[str, Any], new: Dict[str, Any]

+    # so that schemes declared with different scopes are not lost
+    existing_flows = existing.get("flows")
+    new_flows = new.get("flows")
+    if not isinstance(existing_flows, dict) or not isinstance(new_flows, dict):

turns.reply:
Security schemes that share a name but declare different OAuth2 scopes now have their scopes merged in the generated OpenAPI `components.securitySchemes`, instead of the last one overwriting the others. The fix is in `fastapi/openapi/utils.py`.

I checked it with two `OAuth2PasswordBearer` instances named `oa` with scopes `read` and `write`: the components now list both scopes, and each operation keeps its own requirement. The OAuth2 and security-related tests I ran (27) pass.
